name: CreateApiMcpServerCore

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role to assume in the target account when performing cross-account operations with multi-account access enabled
parameters.help_zh: 开启多账号访问进行跨账号操作时，扮演的目标账号 RAM角色名称
parameters.name: assume_role_name

parameters.help_en: The additional policy for role assumption when multi-account access is enabled. If this policy is specified, the permissions for role assumption are based on this value, overriding the permission definitions of the role itself
parameters.help_zh: 开启多账号访问时，角色扮演额外的策略，该策略存在时，角色扮演的权限以当前值为准，覆盖角色本身的权限定义
parameters.name: assume_role_override_policy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-account access
parameters.name: enable_assume_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable a custom VPC whitelist. If this parameter is not enabled, the account-level configuration is used
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自定义VPC白名单，不开启则跟随账户级别的配置
parameters.name: enable_custom_vpc_whitelist

parameters.help_en:
The custom OAuth Client ID used when a custom OAuth configuration is selected.

`Only Web/Native applications are supported, and the OAuth scope must include /acs/mcp-server`
parameters.help_zh:
选择自定义OAuth配置时的自定义OAuth Client ID。

`仅支持 Web/Native 应用，且 OAuth 范围必须包含 /acs/mcp-server`
parameters.name: oauth_client_id

parameters.help_en:
The public network access type: allow public access, disallow public access, or inherit account configuration.
`public` (enabled), `private` (disabled), `inherit` (follows account configuration)
parameters.help_zh:
公网访问类型：允许公网访问、不允许公网访问、继承账号配置。
`public`（开启）, `private`（关闭）, `inherit`（跟随账号配置）
parameters.name: public_access_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC whitelist entries. Each value is a source VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_whitelists

id.description_en: The ID of the API MCP Core service that is created
id.description_zh: 创建成功的 API MCP Core 服务 ID

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for creating an API MCP Core service
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 创建 API MCP Core服务
v1_body_parameters.name: body
